notes:
Service reset and Service functions: the window can be closed while it reads, and a car that cannot be reached is said in seconds instead of minutes.
A rare launcher crash after a module answered too slowly is fixed.
Home marks the best E-Sys to use on this PC: Best match on the newest one that is ready.
New: Car tools > FSC status lists which modules hold feature codes (FSCs) and whether each one is valid. It only reads.
Fault scan: Restart can restart the selected module or all modules, one after the other. The gateway, engine, body and airbag modules are left running, it asks first, and it stops when the car no longer answers.
Car connection check: Windows Firewall blocking E-Sys and a cable adapter with a fixed IP can be fixed with one press. Both ask first.
Car connection check: new Find ICOM button shows the ICOM's address to enter in E-Sys, with a Copy button.
NCD compare: new Save as cheat sheet turns the differences into one cheat in a sheet of its own, ready on the FDL-Editor's Cheats tab.
Cheats with a setting of several bytes, also from the launcher's Sheet Maker, now show on the FDL-Editor's Cheats tab.
